g.title: id: ATLAS_PHASE_1_CURATED_GRAPH label: Pass 1: curated dependency graph layer: atlas_completion_phase type: atlas_completion_phase status: complete meaning: Pass 1: curated dependency graph

id: ATLAS_PHASE_2_STATUS_GATES label: Pass 2: status gates and open problems layer: atlas_completion_phase type: atlas_completion_phase status: complete meaning: Pass 2: status gates and open problems

id: ATLAS_PHASE_3_EQUATION_ANCHORS label: Pass 3: first equation anchors layer: atlas_completion_phase type: atlas_completion_phase status: substantially_complete meaning: Pass 3: first equation anchors
id: ATLAS_PHASE_4_CLAIM_LAYER label: Pass 4: named claim/theorem layer layer: atlas_completion_phase type: atlas_completion_phase status: complete meaning: Pass 4: named claim/theorem layer

id: ATLAS_PHASE_5_SECTION_ANCHORS label: Pass 5: first source-section anchor pass layer: atlas_completion_phase type: atlas_completion_phase status: partial_current_v05 meaning: Pass 5: first source-section anchor pass

id: ATLAS_PHASE_6_PAPER_BACKLINKS label: Pass 6: bidirectional paper backlinks layer: atlas_completion_phase type: atlas_completion_phase status: not_started meaning: Pass 6: bidirectional paper backlinks

id: ATLAS_PHASE_7_NEGATIVE_VALIDATION label: Pass 7: negative/failure-mode validation layer: atlas_completion_phase type: atlas_completion_phase status: complete_v07 meaning: Adds invalid-inference nodes, firewall rules, and negative traversal tests to prevent false upgrades.

id: ATLAS_PHASE_7_QUERY_VALIDATION label: Pass 7: query/use-case validation suite layer: atlas_completion_phase type: atlas_completion_phase status: not_started meaning: Pass 7: query/use-case validation suite

id: ATLAS_CODEX_APPLICATION_REPORT label: Codex application report layer: atlas_meta type: repo_report status: expected_output meaning: Report Codex should produce after applying/validating backlink blocks in the local repository.

id: ATLAS_CODEX_BACKLINK_SWEEP_V08 label: Codex backlink sweep v0.8 layer: atlas_meta type: repo_operation status: handoff_ready meaning: Local Codex operation to insert/validate paper-side atlas backlink blocks in full maintained paper drafts.

id: ATLAS_CURRENT_READINESS_V05 label: Current readiness: usable working atlas, not v1.0 complete layer: atlas_meta type: atlas_meta status: usable_not_complete meaning: Current readiness: usable working atlas, not v1.0 complete

id: ATLAS_CURRENT_READINESS_V06 label: Atlas readiness after v0.6 layer: atlas_meta type: completion_status status: usable_working_base_plus_backlink_register meaning: Curated graph, status gates, claim layer, source-section anchors, and paper backlink register are present. Remaining work: physical insertion into drafts and extended query validation.

id: ATLAS_FULL_PAPER_DRAFTS_EXTERNAL label: Full maintained paper drafts external to assistant workspace layer: atlas_meta type: external_source_set status: not_available_in_workspace meaning: Actual paper drafts that Codex can inspect locally but were not available to this assistant workspace.

id: ATLAS_PAPER_INSERTION_MANIFEST_V08 label: Paper insertion manifest v0.8 layer: atlas_meta type: manifest status: generated meaning: JSON manifest mapping backlink blocks to candidate full-paper files and insertion policies.

id: ATLAS_RULE_PHYS_TO_MATH label: Atlas rule: every equation has physical meaning layer: atlas_meta type: graph_rule status: active meaning: Every equation node should link to a physical object, and every physical object should link to its mathematical representation.
id: ATLAS_V05_STATUS_DASHBOARD label: Atlas v0.5 status/completion dashboard layer: atlas_meta type: atlas_meta status: complete meaning: Atlas v0.5 status/completion dashboard

id: ATLAS_V1_CANDIDATE_GATE label: v1.0 candidate gate layer: atlas_meta type: release_gate status: candidate_if_backlink_register_is_canonical meaning: The atlas is v1-useful if the backlink register is accepted as the paper-side backlink layer; direct insertion into drafts remains optional/manual.
id: ATLAS_V1_COMPLETION_CRITERIA label: Atlas v1.0 completion criteria layer: atlas_meta type: atlas_meta status: defined meaning: Atlas v1.0 completion criteria

id: BACKLINK_REGISTER_V06 label: Paper backlink register v0.6 layer: atlas_meta type: register_artifact status: canonical_register meaning: Canonical paste-ready backlink block register used as source for v0.8 manifest.

id: STATUS_FIREWALL_REGISTER_V07 label: Status firewall register v0.7 layer: atlas_meta type: register_artifact status: canonical_register meaning: Status/firewall rule register that v0.8 Codex sweep must preserve.

id: VIEW_CLAIM_LAYER label: Claim/theorem layer view layer: atlas_meta type: view status: active meaning: Groups equations, physics objects, files, and gates into named claims with explicit status classes.

id: VIEW_EXTENSION_WORKBENCH label: Future-extension workbench view layer: atlas_meta type: view status: active meaning: Reusable navigation view for adding a new derivation target without losing ontology, file anchors, or open gates.

id: VIEW_PAPER_BACKLINK_LAYER_V06 label: Paper backlink layer v0.6 layer: atlas_meta type: view status: v06_complete_as_register meaning: Paste-ready paper/file backlink blocks connecting source files back to atlas IDs.

id: CLAIM_1PN_EIH_WITHIN_HIERARCHY label: 1PN EIH equality within declared hierarchy layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_assembly_within_closure meaning: The full conservative 1PN two-body ledger matches EIH once the declared reduction/closure hierarchy supplies the necessary coefficients. tex_anchor: research/4d_1pn_full/paper/4d_1pn_full.tex:153 label=sec:taxonomy heading=Claim taxonomy

id: CLAIM_25PN_QUAD_NARROWING label: 2.5PN conditional quadrupole narrowing layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: conditional_theorem_open_normalization meaning: The 2.5PN audit demotes scalar/dipole dangers on the natural branch and narrows the universal point-particle route to the orbital/worldtube STF quadrupole, with passive/outgoing normalization still open. tex_anchor: research/4d_2_5pn/paper/4d_2_5pn.tex:151 label=sec:intro-claims heading=What this paper claims

id: CLAIM_2PN_ADM_WITHIN_HIERARCHY label: 2PN ADM equality within declared hierarchy layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_assembly_within_closure meaning: The conservative 2PN two-body ledger Legendre-transforms to the ADM target within the declared hierarchy; it also exposes dipole, P0/P2 support, and geometry-closure structure. tex_anchor: research/4d_2pn/paper/4d_2pn.tex:179 label=sec:intro-claims heading=What this paper claims

id: CLAIM_3PN_GROUPED_P2_WITHIN_HIERARCHY label: 3PN grouped real P2 conservative closure layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_assembly_within_closure meaning: The conservative 3PN ledger is assigned in the fixed ADM chart; the grouped real P2 bundle is the live conservative higher-order payload needing microscopic moving-throat derivation. tex_anchor: research/4d_3pn/paper/4d_3pn.tex:826 label=sec:dict-25pn-bridge heading=Why the 2.5PN notes narrow the next conservative target to the grouped real P 2 bundle

id: CLAIM_4PN_LOCAL_CLOSED_TAIL_CONDITIONAL label: 4PN local sector closed; tail inherits quadrupole gate layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: local_closed_tail_conditional meaning: The local instantaneous 4PN sector is assembled in the declared hierarchy; the full 4PN theorem depends on the same passive/outgoing STF quadrupole normalization isolated at 2.5PN. tex_anchor: research/4d_4pn/paper/4d_4pn.tex:2161 label=sec:tail-bridge heading=Tail / hereditary 4PN bridge

id: CLAIM_5PN_FULL_BUNDLE_SURFACE label: 5PN full-bundle surface and weak-axisymmetric continuation layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_within_reduced_bundle_open_branch meaning: The 5PN/moving-throat continuation gives exact isotropic full-bundle target surfaces and weak-axisymmetric quotient/orbit structures, but the actual branch still must land on them.

id: CLAIM_ATOMIC_HYDROGEN_ZERO_MODE label: Hydrogenic sector as reduced zero-mode consequence layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: reduced_sector_consequence meaning: The hydrogenic/atomic sector is a reduced brane-effective consequence of the zero-mode Maxwell/Coulomb limit, not a solved full moving-throat theorem.

id: CLAIM_BRANCH_EXPORTER_REQUIRED label: Actual target-blind branch exporter required layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: open_actual_branch meaning: The program must produce target-blind branch data before comparison; executable fixtures and smoke tests do not close the theorem without a physical branch exporter.

id: CLAIM_CHARGE_ONTOLOGY_FIREWALL label: Corrected electric-charge ontology firewall layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_bookkeeping_firewall meaning: Electric sign is eta_Q, microscopic branch charge is q_star, brane charge is q_eff=q_star/sqrt(Z_int), and circulation is magnetic/vortical rather than electric charge. tex_anchor: research/4d/paper/4d.tex:250 heading=Minimal coupling and covariant derivatives.

id: CLAIM_FACING_MOUTH_SWIRL_CONDITIONAL label: Facing-mouth opposite local swirl attraction is closure-conditional layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_within_fixed_current_orientation_closure meaning: With a fixed-current/current-like coaxial closure, a real tangential swirl circulation, and oriented area vectors, facing local normals give sigma1*sigma2=-1, so opposite local swirl labels attract; this is not a fluxoid-only theorem.

id: CLAIM_FLUXOID_SINGLE_VALUED_PSI_QUANTIZATION label: Fluxoid integer winding from single-valued psi layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_identity_audit meaning: The circulation package derives Delta_theta in 2*pi*Z from psi(2*pi)=psi(0), verifies single-valued chi contributes zero loop winding, and preserves eta_Q as a separate electric branch label.

id: CLAIM_G2_COMMON_QUOTIENT label: g-2 common correction through quotient/prefactor slope layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: conditional_reduced_residual meaning: The anomaly residual is organized as a common quotient/prefactor slope Xi1=P1/P0 or q_tr/q_nt/q_eta packet rather than another staggered one-sided charge/inertia update.

id: CLAIM_LEPTON_HALF_INTEGER_CONDITIONAL label: Lepton half-integer mixed-sector route is conditional layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: conditional_open meaning: A same-charge mixed-sector Berry rotor can force half-integer quantization only if the selective tau-subbundle, central sign holonomy, and autonomous self-reproducing soliton closure hold.

id: CLAIM_LEPTON_MASS_REDUCED_LEDGER label: Lepton mass partition as reduced defect-energy theorem layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: reduced_closure_theorem_open_scale meaning: The isolated lepton mass ledger fixes the 11:2:5 partition and total/rest-energy relation within the reduced closure, while the absolute branch scale remains open.

id: CLAIM_MATERIAL_CLOSURE_GAP label: Material closure must be solved on same branch layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: open meaning: Density, sound speed, effective light cone, flux feedback, and material screening must be exported on the same branch as the response packet.

id: CLAIM_MAXWELL_GAUGE_LOCALIZATION_PATCH label: Maxwell gauge-fixing localization patch layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: safe_interpretation_or_structural_patch meaning: The unweighted Lorenz term is consistent as a bulk gauge device but singular as a noncompact zero-mode gauge-fixed action; the atlas records either impose Lorenz before reduction or use localized H(w), preferably H=Z.

id: CLAIM_MIXED_CIRCULATION_PLUMBING_CONDITIONAL label: Mixed-sector circulation force sign remains Lambda_A-conditional layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: conditional_open_plumbing meaning: Step 06 verifies that N0 is a nonnegative square-over-square transfer magnitude and includes it in the force, but Lambda_A remains real/open; facing-mouth opposite local swirl attraction requires Lambda1*Lambda2*N0>0.

id: CLAIM_MIXED_RECIRCULATION_OPEN label: Mixed recirculation/plumbing law remains open layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: open meaning: The EM ontology needs a closed mixed recirculation law relating circulation, throat intake, mixed transport, brane magnetic fields, source current, and the sign of the effective current coefficient Lambda_A.

id: CLAIM_MIXED_SECTOR_MICROSCOPIC label: Mixed EM sector is microscopic ontology, not gauge artifact layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_gauge_invariant_with_reduced_uses meaning: A_w, F_mu_w, J^w, E_w, and C_a are retained in the parent/microscopic ontology and are the natural carriers for leakage, beyond-MHD structure, and outgoing quadrupole transfer. tex_anchor: research/4d_em_fields/paper/4d_em_fields.tex:1348 heading=When the 3+1 Maxwell limit holds

id: CLAIM_NO_UNIVERSAL_FORCE_FROM_FLUXOID label: Fluxoid alone gives no universal 3D radial force sign layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_negative_within_3d_closure_analysis meaning: The circulation package shows that n fixes holonomy but not the current/plumbing coefficient, orientation sign, mutual-inductance closure, or ensemble, so no universal attraction/repulsion sign follows from n1*n2 alone in 3D.

id: CLAIM_PACKET_A_PACKET_B_SPLIT label: Packet A / Packet B target split layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: open_branch_packets meaning: Current moving-throat finish line separates conservative/outgoing grouped target data (Packet A) from orbit-lock/weak-axisymmetric data (Packet B), both requiring actual branch realization.

id: CLAIM_PARENT_ACTION_CURRENT_EXACT label: Current parent action and exact bulk equations layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_parent_current meaning: The declared 4+1 parent stack supplies gauged GNLS matter, localized Maxwell, exact bulk current/continuity, and mixed-sector observables, with Sigma/R currently entering through confinement. tex_anchor: research/4d_em_fields/paper/4d_em_fields.tex:245 label=sec:conventions_action heading=Conventions and localized 5D Maxwell action

id: CLAIM_PARENT_WALL_STATUS_SPLIT label: Parent wall status split: force yes, autonomous PDE no layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: strict_parent_fail_effective_wall_pass meaning: The confinement-only parent supplies a wall force/source but no autonomous wall PDE; S_eta^(2) is a consistent linear effective closure and must be promoted to S_Sigma for parent-level dynamics.

id: CLAIM_PROJECTED_EM_OUTGOING_BRIDGE label: Projection-first EM packet feeds the outgoing bridge layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_projection_with_reduced_adapter meaning: The current PDE ledger projects the EM sector before reduction in Stages 004--020, then retains the reduced one-port Stage 021 adapter to transfer the passive/outgoing l=2 fingerprint into the grouped normalization bridge.

id: CLAIM_PROJECTION_OPEN_BRANE_SYSTEM label: Projection makes the brane an open subsystem layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_projection_plus_controlled_hook meaning: Projection with W(w) gives exact projected continuity with leakage; the longitudinal identity becomes the Poisson hook only in a controlled quasi-static/longitudinal regime. tex_anchor: research/4d_plasma/paper/4d_plasma.tex:252 label=sec:projection_defs heading=Localization and Projection Operators

id: CLAIM_RESPONSE_READOUT_DISCIPLINE label: D0/C/P0/N2/N4 are response readouts, not the throat itself layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: paper_facing_ontology_discipline meaning: Compressed quantities such as D0, C, P0, N2, and N4 should be treated as branch response readouts downstream of the physical throat/mouth/interior/support/mixed system, not as substitutes for that physical system.

id: CLAIM_STAGE022_P0_TARGET label: Stage 022 grouped P2 bridge isolates P0 target layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_within_grouped_bridge meaning: Stage 022 translates the projection-first EM packet and retained one-port adapter into grouped real P2 response language. The leading odd 2.5PN coefficient depends only on the isotropic static outgoing prefactor P0=N0/D0, with target mhat0^2 P0=54 G c_s^5/(5 a^5 c^5). tex_anchor: research/4d_2_5pn/paper/4d_2_5pn.tex:4995 label=app:quadrupole-normalization-package heading=Quadrupole normalization package

id: CLAIM_STAGE023_FULL_BUNDLE_RATIO label: Stage 023 full grouped bundle reduces isotropic target to N0/(K-B0-Z0) layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_within_reduced_bundle meaning: Stage 023 writes the full grouped real 20/21/22 bundle, tracking wall, BdG, projection-first Maxwell/matched one-port, and outgoing data. On the isotropic branch the normalization test is mhat0^2 N0/(K-B0-Z0) against the universal target.

id: CLAIM_STAGE024_O3_ISOTROPY label: Stage 024 O(3) isotropy and weak-axisymmetric splitting theorem layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_angular_reduced meaning: The angular source map is identity on the canonical real STF basis; O(3)-invariant kernels force grouped-lane isotropy, while weak axisymmetric splitting has signature (1,1/2,-1) or b=3a. tex_anchor: research/4d_2_5pn/paper/4d_2_5pn.tex:2248 label=sec:quadrupole-surviving-source-map heading=The universal source is the orbital/worldtube STF quadrupole

id: CLAIM_STAGE025_031_SELECTED_BRANCH label: Stages 025--031 selected-mode spectral reachability packet layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_within_selected_reduced_branch meaning: Stages 025--031 compress the radial/axial selected-branch problem into a concrete finite-throat spectral-transfer/reachability test for P0 before wall softening.

id: CLAIM_STAGE1_GEOMETRY_LIFT label: Distributed Sigma/R geometry lift layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: effective_geometry_lift meaning: The throat is represented as Sigma=r-R(Omega,w,t), so a(t), L(t) become collective moments and scalar/P2/geometry lanes become explicit wall/support modes.

id: CLAIM_STAGE2_AL_RECOVERY label: Old a,L closure recovered as lowest wall truncation layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_within_wall_action meaning: The axisymmetric two-mode wall ansatz reduces the distributed wall theory back to an (a,L)-type matrix closure, while P2 is the next harmonic family of the same action.

id: CLAIM_STAGE3_BDG_SCHUR label: BdG-wall Schur complement gives even support ladder layer: claim_theorem type: claim status: exact_within_reduced_stable_modes meaning: Stable BdG support modes integrate out by Schur complement, lowering static stiffness, increasing inertia, and generating the even low-frequency ladder for scalar and grouped P2 lanes.

id: PHYS_MIXED_EM_CORE label: Mixed brane-bulk EM core layer: physical_ontology type: field_sector status: exact_parent_observables_reduced_open meaning: Hidden brane-bulk EM transport channels retained microscopically outside strict zero-mode brane reduction.

id: PHYS_MOUTH_CROSS_SECTION label: Brane-side mouth layer: physical_ontology type: geometry_feature status: physical_ontology meaning: The brane entrance cross-section of the throat; not the entire defect.

id: PHYS_MOUTH_INTERIOR_FIREWALL label: Mouth/interior distinction layer: physical_ontology type: ontology_firewall status: paper_facing_required meaning: The brane-side mouth is only the entrance cross-section; internal support, throughput, transfer, and outgoing data live deeper in the throat.

id: PHYS_OPEN_CONDUIT label: Open finite-radius conduit layer: physical_ontology type: boundary_condition status: effective_branch_condition meaning: Physical branch is an open finite-radius throat/outlet; hard cap is obsolete toy idealization unless declared as negative control.

id: PHYS_OPEN_FINITE_EXIT label: Open finite-radius exit layer: physical_ontology type: geometry_boundary status: effective_branch_condition meaning: The physically preferred throat branch has a finite exit into the bulk/reservoir side, R(L)>0, not a hard cap R(L)=0.

id: PHYS_OUTGOING_QUADRUPOLE_PORT label: Passive/outgoing quadrupole port layer: physical_ontology type: radiative_port status: open_actual_branch_data meaning: Surviving universal dissipative/tail bridge after scalar and dipole demotion; requires actual branch normalization.

id: PHYS_RESPONSE_READOUTS label: Compressed response readouts layer: physical_ontology type: readout_interpretation status: not_physical_object meaning: D0, C, P0, N2, N4 are low-order projected response readouts of the throat branch, not the throat itself.

id: PHYS_SUPERFLUID_INTAKE_OUTPUT label: Superfluid intake/output channels layer: physical_ontology type: open_system_flux status: open_physical_closure meaning: Open throat has flux-like intake/output channels that must not be identified by fiat; they feed leakage, work, and export-kernel questions.

id: PHYS_SUPERFLUID_MEDIUM label: Bulk superfluid/GNLS medium layer: physical_ontology type: medium status: exact_declared_parent meaning: The substrate carrying density, current, EOS, sound speed, and support dynamics.

id: PHYS_TARGET_BLIND_BRANCH_SELECTION label: Target-blind branch selection layer: physical_ontology type: protocol_principle status: mandatory meaning: The actual branch must be frozen before target evaluation; post-hoc fitting to GR/PN residuals is prohibited by the audit.

id: PHYS_REG_BRANCH_EXPORT label: Actual branch physical spine layer: physical_register type: register status: active meaning: Final theorem work requires a target-blind branch exporter that returns physical profile, material, support, mixed, and readout packets before target comparison.

id: PHYS_REG_CHARGE_EM label: Charge/EM physical spine layer: physical_register type: register status: active meaning: Electric sign, brane charge magnitude, magnetic/vortical circulation, and mixed-core transport are separate objects.

id: PHYS_REG_OBSERVER_PROJECTION label: Observer/projection physical spine layer: physical_register type: register status: active meaning: Brane observation is projection with W(w), while brane effective laws are reductions under extra assumptions.

id: PHYS_REG_OUTGOING_PORT label: Outgoing port physical spine layer: physical_register type: register status: active meaning: The radiative/outgoing route is a passive l=2 port coupled through the mixed sector and measured by the P0/N0/D0 response readout.

id: PHYS_REG_P2_QUAD label: Grouped P2/quadrupole physical spine layer: physical_register type: register status: active meaning: Grouped P2 is a physical mouth/support shape-response bundle tied to the orbital/worldtube STF quadrupole, not a symbolic coefficient list.

id: PHYS_REG_PARTICLE_THROAT label: Particle/throat physical spine layer: physical_register type: register status: active meaning: Particle-like object = finite brane-bulk throat/mouth/interior/open-conduit system; math stack should not collapse it to a point too early.
id: NEG_QUERY_25PN_UNCONDITIONAL label: Is the 2.5PN package an unconditional solved moving-throat PDE theorem? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: NEG_QUERY_CHARGE_FROM_CIRCULATION label: Can electric charge sign be derived from circulation or magnetic/vortical winding? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: NEG_QUERY_CURRENT_PARENT_HAS_AUTONOMOUS_WALL_PDE label: Does the current confinement-only parent action already produce an autonomous moving-wall PDE? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query
id: NEG_QUERY_G2_COMMON_LAYER_CLOSED label: Does the g-2 common quotient layer already close the anomaly residual? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: NEG_QUERY_GAUGE_FIXING_LOCALIZATION_IGNORED label: Can the unlocalized Maxwell gauge-fixing term be ignored without a safe interpretation or patch? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: NEG_QUERY_HYDROGEN_FULL_MOVING_THROAT_THEOREM label: Does the hydrogenic zero-mode reduction prove full atomic structure from the solved moving-throat PDE? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query
id: NEG_QUERY_KAPPARHO_AS_ELECTRIC_CHARGE label: Can the gravity-side coefficient kappa_rho=1 be read as electric charge? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query
id: NEG_QUERY_LEPTON_HALF_INTEGER_PROVED label: Is the half-integer lepton route already proved by the frozen files alone? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: NEG_QUERY_LOCAL_4PN_CLOSES_FULL_TAIL label: Does exact local instantaneous 4PN assembly by itself close the full 4PN tail theorem? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query
id: NEG_QUERY_PROJECTION_EQUALS_REDUCTION label: Are brane projection and brane reduction the same operation? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query
id: NEG_QUERY_QEFF_FROM_THROAT_GEOMETRY label: Can q_eff be inferred from throat radius, length, or breathing variables? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query
id: NEG_QUERY_READOUTS_ARE_PHYSICAL_THROAT label: Are D0, C, P0, N2, and N4 themselves the physical throat? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: NEG_QUERY_SIMILARITY_ORBIT_SOLVES_FULL_5PN label: Does the monomial/similarity-orbit theorem solve the full 5PN continuation? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query
id: NEG_QUERY_STF_ANGULAR_MAP_CLOSES_RADIAL_NORMALIZATION label: Does mhat_ang=1 close the full quadrupole normalization? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: NEG_QUERY_WALL_COEFFS_ARE_FIT_KNOBS label: Can wall-action coefficients be freely refit stage by stage to rescue normalization? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: NEG_QUERY_ZERO_MODE_ERASES_MIXED_CORE label: Does the zero-mode Maxwell reduction remove A_w, J^w, and F_mu w from the microscopic ontology? layer: query_validation type: negative_query_test status: v07_negative_query

id: QUERY_4PN_TAIL_BLOCKER label: What blocks full 4PN tail completion? layer: query_validation type: query_test status: v06_seed_query meaning: 4PN local is closed within hierarchy; full tail inherits the 2.5PN passive/outgoing STF quadrupole normalization gate.

id: QUERY_G2_XI1 label: How does the anomaly branch connect to the moving-throat quotient? layer: query_validation type: query_test status: v06_seed_query meaning: The anomaly/g-2 branch uses q_tr,q_nt,q_eta and the Xi1=P1/P0 prefactor slope on the weak-axisymmetric branch.

id: QUERY_MATERIAL_CLOSURE label: What remains open about material closure? layer: query_validation type: query_test status: v06_seed_query meaning: Material/superfluid closure must be solved on the same moving-throat branch and is not replaced by response readout algebra.

id: QUERY_MIXED_SECTOR label: Why can the outgoing bridge use the mixed sector? layer: query_validation type: query_test status: v06_seed_query meaning: Mixed fields are microscopic gauge-invariant channels; Stage 4 uses localized Maxwell/mixed coordinates to carry the outgoing quadrupole bridge.

id: QUERY_P2_BECOMES_PHYSICAL label: Where does grouped P2 become physical geometry? layer: query_validation type: query_test status: v06_seed_query meaning: Stage 1 makes grouped P2 a real wall/support mode; later stages add BdG, mixed/outgoing bridge, full bundle, and O(3) isotropy.

id: QUERY_PARENT_WALL_STATUS label: What changes if S_eta or S_Sigma is not promoted? layer: query_validation type: query_test status: v06_seed_query meaning: Confinement-only parent gives wall force/source but not autonomous wall PDE; parent promotion remains an open gate.

id: QUERY_READOUT_DISCIPLINE label: Are D0, C, P0, N2, N4 physical throat objects? layer: query_validation type: query_test status: v06_seed_query meaning: They are compressed response readouts; the physical throat/mouth/interior/support layers sit upstream and require branch export.

id: QUERY_ZERO_MODE_DOWNSTREAM label: What depends on zero-mode Maxwell? layer: query_validation type: query_test status: v06_seed_query meaning: Hydrogen/atomic reduced sector and brane Maxwell/Coulomb branch depend on controlled zero-mode Maxwell, while mixed core remains microscopic.

id: FIREWALL_25PN_CONDITIONAL label: Preserve the conditional theorem status of 2.5PN until actual branch normalization is realized. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. It narrows the universal branch and leaves passive/outgoing quadrupole normalization open.

id: FIREWALL_4PN_LOCAL_NOT_FULL_TAIL label: Keep local instantaneous 4PN closure separate from the inherited passive/outgoing quadrupole normalization gate. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. The local sector is assembled, but the tail inherits the 2.5PN quadrupole-normalization gate.

id: FIREWALL_ANGULAR_NOT_RADIAL label: Do not convert the exact angular identity mhat_ang=1 into a solved radial/axial normalization theorem. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. The angular source map closes only the angular basis; radial/axial and port-amplitude data remain open.

id: FIREWALL_ATOM_REDUCED_SECTOR label: Label atomic hydrogen as a reduced-sector consequence, not a completed full-defect PDE theorem. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. It is a controlled reduced-sector derivation using the zero-mode Maxwell/Coulomb branch.

id: FIREWALL_CHARGE_NOT_CIRCULATION label: Do not identify circulation, throat geometry, or magnetic/vortical winding with electric charge sign. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. Electric charge sign is eta_Q; circulation belongs to the magnetic/vortical sector.

id: FIREWALL_G2_COMMON_CONDITIONAL label: Preserve the common-layer status as a sharp conditional target until the actual moving-throat branch tangent is computed. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. It reduces the residual to a precise quotient/prefactor tangent target, but the actual branch tangent is still open.

id: FIREWALL_KAPPARHO_NOT_CHARGE label: Do not recycle the historical gravity-side q=1 notation as electromagnetic charge. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. kappa_rho is a mass-dressing/Newtonian scalar coefficient, not the EM charge label.

id: FIREWALL_LEPTON_CONDITIONAL label: Keep the lepton same-charge quantizer as a conditional theorem until the autonomous/recirculation closure is file-grounded. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. It is conditionally viable under selective subbundle, central holonomy, and autonomous eigenmode closure assumptions.

id: FIREWALL_MAXWELL_GAUGE_PATCH_REQUIRED label: Carry the weighted-gauge-fixing caveat/patch in any derivation that uses localized Maxwell equations beyond the safe zero-mode reading. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. The weighted gauge-fixing audit requires either a safe reading or localized H(w)-style patch.

id: FIREWALL_PARENT_WALL_NOT_STRICT label: Do not upgrade the moving-wall PDE to strict parent-level status unless S_eta/S_Sigma is included. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. It gives a wall force/source; an autonomous wall PDE requires S_eta or S_Sigma.

id: FIREWALL_PROJECTION_NOT_REDUCTION label: Projection is an exact measurement definition; reduction is a controlled dynamical simplification. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. Projection defines observables with W(w); reduction imposes additional ansatz/regime assumptions.

id: FIREWALL_QEFF_THICKNESS_NOT_BREATHING label: Keep microscopic branch charge q_star and observed brane coupling q_eff separate from throat radius/length dynamics. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. q_eff is thickness-controlled through Z_int after zero-mode normalization.

id: FIREWALL_READOUTS_NOT_THROAT label: Keep response packets downstream of the physical throat, mouth, support, mixed, and outgoing branch data. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. They are compressed response readouts produced by the physical mouth/interior/support/mixed branch.

id: FIREWALL_SIMILARITY_NOT_FULL_5PN label: Treat the similarity/orbit theorem as a normalization-defect theorem, not as closure of the separate conservative even gates. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. It controls Xi_load/P1/P0, but K1 and H_even remain separate conservative even gates.

id: FIREWALL_WALL_COEFFS_BRANCH_DATA label: Treat wall constitutive coefficients as computed/constrained branch data, not as adjustable rescue parameters. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. If S_eta/S_Sigma is used, its coefficients are branch data or constitutive data, not post-hoc knobs.

id: FIREWALL_ZERO_MODE_NOT_MIXED_ERASURE label: Treat A_w, J^w, F_{mu w}, E_w, and C_a as suppressed in the brane limit, not deleted. layer: status_audit type: status_firewall_rule status: active_v07 meaning: No. It suppresses mixed channels only in the controlled far-field brane limit.

id: MT_V2_13_GROUPED_NORMALIZATION label: V2-13 grouped normalization ratio audit layer: status_audit type: audit_gate status: exact_within_bundle meaning: Defines normalized response, outgoing prefactor, constant-prefactor branch, and isotropic full-bundle surface.

id: MT_V2_14_L2_OUTGOING label: V2-14 compact outgoing l=2 fingerprint layer: status_audit type: audit_gate status: exact_reduced meaning: Derives the compact outgoing l=2 fingerprint and its coefficient in the normalized compliance language.

id: MT_V2_15_25PN_4PN_INTERFACE label: V2-15 2.5PN/4PN interface audit layer: status_audit type: interface_gate status: conditional_on_quadrupole_normalization meaning: Shows the same quadrupole normalization controls both the 2.5PN Burke-Thorne branch and the 4PN tail coefficient.

id: MT_V2_16_NO_REFIT label: V2-16 branch-freeze/no-refit protocol layer: status_audit type: protocol_gate status: mandatory meaning: Freeze action status, gauge convention, branch class, support basis, ports, stability gates, extraction formulas before target comparison.

id: MT_V2_17_WEAK_AXISYM label: V2-17 weak-axisymmetric P2 splitting audit layer: status_audit type: audit_gate status: exact_first_order meaning: Freezes weak-axisymmetric grouped signature, hidden-even relation, outgoing-prefactor transport, and Xi1 packet.

id: MT_V2_18_MONOMIAL_ORBIT label: V2-18 monomial quotient and similarity-orbit audit layer: status_audit type: audit_gate status: exact_within_coherent_branch meaning: Derives q_tr, q_nt, q_eta quotient coordinates, similarity orbit, and Xi1 bridge.

id: MT_V2_19_TARGET_SURFACE label: V2-19 isotropic full-bundle target surface layer: status_audit type: target_gate status: exact_within_reduced_bundle meaning: Freezes full isotropic target packet: one-pole response, quadrupole normalization, constant-prefactor branch, tail transport.

id: MT_V2_21_BRANCH_FIXTURE label: V2-21 branch-extraction fixture layer: status_audit type: fixture_gate status: implemented meaning: Defines primitive/direct coefficient inputs, open-throat gate, extraction formulas, grouped decomposition, residuals, and stability gates.

id: MT_V2_22A_PROFILE_ADAPTER label: V2-22A profile-to-coefficient adapter layer: status_audit type: adapter_gate status: implemented meaning: Converts profile overlaps into reduced couplings, lane coefficients, response, prefactor, and weak-axisymmetric options.

id: MT_V2_22B_SOLVER_SCHEMA label: V2-22B numerical branch profile schema layer: status_audit type: solver_schema_gate status: implemented meaning: Defines solver export schema, validation gates, and conversion into profile manifest; rejects hard-cap negative control.

id: MT_V2_22C_SMOKE_PIPELINE label: V2-22C branch-realization smoke pipeline layer: status_audit type: pipeline_gate status: implemented_control_and_smoke meaning: Runs end-to-end branch realization smoke pipeline, tolerance budget, and calibrated direct-coefficient control.

id: MT_V2_23_OPEN_BRANCH_SOLVER label: V2-23 minimal open-throat branch solver layer: status_audit type: simulation_gate status: target_miss meaning: First target-blind branch families did not land on target packet.

id: MT_V2_25_ACTUAL_BRANCH_PROTOCOL label: V2-25 actual branch protocol layer: status_audit type: protocol_gate status: open_actual_branch meaning: Defines post-miss coefficient map, outgoing prefactor, moment-shape conditions, Packet A/B, notes intake, and no-refit rules.

id: MT_V2_26_STATUS label: V2-26 post-audit program status layer: status_audit type: status_summary status: boundary_set meaning: Reduced/effective framework is internally consistent and executable, but actual branch realization is unsolved.

id: MT_V2_27_EXECUTABLE_AUDIT label: V2-27 executable audit implementation layer: status_audit type: reproducibility_gate status: referee_harness_pass meaning: Records executable harness: audit scripts, fixture checks, simulations, Mathematica mirrors, and reproducibility status.

id: READOUT_D0_C_P0_N2_N4 label: Reduced response readout packet layer: status_audit type: readout_packet status: compressed_target_readouts meaning: Low-order projected response moments used to test branch; not full physical description.

id: STATUS_LADDER_EXACT_TO_OPEN label: Claim status ladder layer: status_audit type: status_taxonomy status: active meaning: Canonical status ladder for v0.4: exact, controlled_reduction, protocol_closure, exact_within_closure, reduced_sector_consequence, conditional_theorem, effective_closure, patched_required, open.
